about: Each finding of the jornada03 study (jornada03/REPORT.md, J1–J28) and the tests that replay its path and assert the fix: a browser test (spec file and title), a scenario of the manifest (feature and id, run through every door by the browser runner), a unit test (file and title) or the performance gate. tools/inventory/jornada03.test.ts holds every J to at least one, and every one named to a test that exists.

J1.test: J1: a variable typed as a border colour reaches every side, and nothing fails in silence
a style state the next selection does not take goes back to Base, and the editor stays drawn
writes a one-value token into every side of a border colour on

J2.test: letters typed after a press away from the canvas run nothing and say why; Escape chooses the canvas again

J3.test: import offers three destinations and adds a page without changing either client page

J4.test: spaces typed in a button edited in place are kept

J5.test: J5: a long variables list scrolls inside the Styles view and leaves the Layers where they are

J6.test: paired resting values remain readable and editing keeps full units, stepping and reset

J7.test: Ctrl+Z in a field just kept with Enter undoes the change, and Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes it
an immediate undo after Enter needs no extra click or wait

J8.test: opening a floating panel preserves its placement and its close button still works
outside press cancels the preview before selecting another element
the Source field chooses a project file from its picker, and Escape or the close button leaves the picker

J10.test: a breakpoint that inherits two columns shows them, and editing one writes the list there only

J11.test: reads a text without its accents, in any case
finds an entry by its synonyms and its English name, then by its tag

J12.test: F6 walks the focus through the editor regions and Shift+F6 walks it back
F6 puts the keys on the canvas page itself, with a visible focus, and walks on from there

J14.test: the exported page has the canvas\'s computed styles at every breakpoint
semantic roles translated to code language, custom names retained
class identity stable across page order and genuinely different variants

J15.test: opening and exploring the font list leaves the unfinished text uncommitted
the project’s fonts lead the font menu, in Essentials only and in All properties
J15: the font menu is drawn whole inside the window

J16.test: says it covers content when text surrounds the element on every side

J19.test: a 1px border reads 1px at a canvas zoom below 100 %, and the Shadow row says the shadow

J20.test: J20: a duplicated page opens, right after its source, with its name ready to type

J21.test: J21: an instance’s Layers row names its component

J22.test: J22: an image without a source draws a 16:9 marker no wider than 640 px

J23.test: canvas text returns after reload with editing open and remains a single undoable confirmation

J25.test: at 1280 × 720 the canvas has half of the window and the canvas toolbar fits whole

J26.test: a Portuguese browser opens a Portuguese editor, and a chosen language stays chosen
a fresh editor opens on the Insert panel, which the View menu names Insert

J27.test: a box link belongs to its element: linking one title leaves the other unlinked

J28.test: J28: Portuguese says an insertion without agreeing with its name, and one element in the singular
chooses the plural form of a count by the rules of the locale, zero in the plural
